dedupe_keys.name: nerc nigeria electricity supply industry reports and performance data quarterly reports operational and commercial factsheets

description: The Nigerian Electricity Regulatory Commission (NERC) publishes quarterly reports on the Nigerian Electricity Supply Industry (NESI), prepared under section 56(3) of the Electricity Act 2023, which analyse its operational and commercial performance. On 28 September 2026 the reports page listed quarterly reports up to the first quarter of 2026, annual reports for 2022, 2024 and 2025, and the 2023 market competition report. The Statistics and Performance Data section adds an operational performance factsheet (December 2025), key operational and financial data of the industry for January 2019 to September 2022, distribution companies' energy sales by service band (November 2020 to September 2022), meter deployment status, transmission company performance improvement plans, and weekly customer complaint analyses from 2020; the site also lists commercial and metering factsheets. Coverage is national, by distribution company and transmission company; resolution is monthly to quarterly aggregates. Format and access: PDF reports and factsheets. Licence: not stated. Free. Caveats: data sit in PDFs, some series stop in 2022, and the operational data and infographics page returned a server error. Simulation uses: generation, transmission and distribution performance, energy sales and collection figures for power sector reliability and planning studies. Related records: complements the Nigeria building footprints with energy typology and rooftop solar potential.
